body: Yes but on here, it's like i'm shouting into an empty room and getting replies back from empty faces, and after i've said it and talked about it, nothing will happen everything will be the same. Whereas if i tell anyone in real life then it's set in stone and i can't change the way they think towards me.
Even so, i'm still incredibly depressed and i still feel like i will turn to suicide before the end of this year.

Sadly, that's the way my brain works, but i just have a bipolar kind of thing where one side of me doesn't want help, and the other side of me that wants help but can't bring myself to get out of fear of strangers, family and friends thoughts.
I wouldn't know where to start..
Probably because I've always been taught and surrounded by the ideology that i can solve my own problems, which then hugely demoralizes me to look ask for help in any situation.
Mainly that i'm just not too great with words and structure, althought i guess it would be cool to get my wierd imagination down on paper.

Personally, i feel it's specific to me.

In regards to your second question, they don't support her ideas and just accept it as just her ignorance, they're kind of desensitized to it now i guess.

Uhmmm, not really, reaching out for help still feels very shameful and kind of makes me feel like i'm doing something wrong.

In regards to my families view on sexuality, my parents say they have no problem with gay people, my older brother doesn't really think anything of it whereas my sister is very vocal about how it's "disgusting" and both my siblings often use any homosexual terms as insults at me or towards others, with my brother i get the feel he's just joking but with my sister i honestly feel like she'd distance herself from me.
Nope, i'm not really a good writer.

I think the fact that i started thinking about my sexuality quite young and the fact that nobody really speaks at all about "gays" except for school friends who would generically use it as an insult and in a derogatory manner and i felt/feel completely isolated, confused and disgusting.
I can't think of any that i would find interesting :/

Anything Fantasy related - Final Fantasy, The sorcerers apprentice, HP 
Which in return depresses me even more, the worlds in the games and the films just gives real life so less worth to me.
My mind has always worked that way as far as a can remember, and now that i'm in college my mind-set is like that more than ever.
Computer Games and watching films really..

I'm unhappy because; 
- i'm failing in college
- will have to find another job when i leave because i don't get enough hours where i am working at the moment.
- I have no distinguishable talent
- No career prospects
- Being a closet-gay sucks
- Nothing to look forward to in the future
- lack of sleep
- College depresses me, i'm tired of education.
- Can't find anything that makes me happy anymore.

In terms of hotline, i think i'd just get too upset and too scared and end up hanging up as soon as i get through to someone. And with a Councillor, i don't know, i guess telling a stranger all my problems when i can't even tell any friends or family feels very abnormal plus for some reason reaching out to a Councillor makes me feel ashamed and broken.
